column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. “In the congregation of God” is rendered “in His own congregation,” and “the gods” as “the rulers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lift up the face of the wicked” is rendered “show partiality to the wicked.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the poor” is rendered “the weak,” and the verbs are exchanged between the lines.
“You have an inheritance among all the nations” is rendered “it is You who possess all the nations.”
